resources.string: E tatari ana ki te ararere ororongo
Kōrero takitahi ki te AI, anō nei he waea.

Ka whakamahi a Puzru i tētahi whakamōhiotanga ngū hei whakaatu kei te kā, ā, kua rite ki te ararere ororongo, tae atu ki te wā kei muri te taupānga. He mea kōwhiri ngā whakamōhiotanga; ka mahi tonu a Puzru me te kore aua whakamōhiotanga.
Haere tonu me te kore whakamōhiotanga
Whakaaetia a Iti ki runga i ētahi atu taupānga

Me whai a Iti i te urunga “Whakaatu ki runga i ētahi atu taupānga” a Android kia kitea tonutia i a koe e whakamahi ana i tētahi taupānga reo e tautokona ana. I te mata e whai ake nei, tīpakohia a Puzru i te rārangi, kātahi ka whakakā i tēnei urunga. He mea kōwhiri tēnei urunga, ā, kāore e āhei a Puzru ki te pānui, ki te whakahaere rānei i ētahi atu taupānga. Ka mahi te ararere ororongo me te kore a Iti.
Pūmana mānu a Puzru. Tūnga: %1$s. Ngā mana hiko, whakawhānui me te kati.

Kāore a Puzru e tono pūkete, whakaaetanga hopureo rānei, ā, kāore e hopu, e tuhi rānei i te ororongo hopureo, i ngā ihirangi kōrerorero rānei.

Ka whakamahi a Puzru i ngā mōhiohio hangarau o te pūnaha ororongo Android mō te ararere me te tātaritanga, ā, ka tukatukahia ēnei i runga tonu i te pūrere.

Kāore ngā pūrongo tātaritanga e tiakina, e tukuna aunoatia rānei. Me mārama tonu te mahi a te kaiwhakamahi hei tiaki pūrongo, hei tuku rānei ki tētahi atu taupānga.
Me Android 13, he mea hōu ake rānei, hei tīpako reo i roto i te taupānga. Ka whai tēnei pūrere i te reo o te pūnaha.
Whakawetohia te mata ina tata ki tō taringa

Nā Napahu Studios a Puzru

Te tikanga o te ingoa
I ahu mai te ingoa Puzru i tētahi kupu Akkadian e pā ana ki te huna, ki te matatapu rānei. E whakaatu ana tēnei i te kaupapa o te taupānga: kia iti ake te tūpono ka rangona e te hunga e tata ana te purei reo AI e tautokona ana.

Ngā mahi a Puzru
Ka āwhina a Puzru ki te ararere i te purei reo AI e tautokona ana ki te kaikorero-taringa kua hangaia ki tō waea, kia rangona ai ngā whakautu anō nei he waea noa, kaua e whakatangihia mā te kaikōrero matua.

Ka whakawhirinaki a Puzru ki ngā āhuatanga ararere ororongo paerewa a Android. Kei tō pūrere, tō putanga Android, me te āhua o te whakahaere a ia taupānga, ratonga rānei i te ororongo reo te hototahitanga.

Hototahitanga me ngā tepenga
• He rerekē te mahi o ngā āhuatanga reo i ia taupānga, i ia ratonga.
• Tērā pea me ohauru mō ētahi aratau reo, ka whakawhāitihia rānei e te rohe, e te pūkete rānei, kāore rānei e wātea.
• Kāore a Puzru e wetewete, e whakawhānui, e hipa rānei i ngā āhuatanga e whakaratohia ana e ngā ratonga hunga kē.

Ngā mea kāore e mahia e Puzru
• Kāore e waea atu.
• Kāore e whakahaere, e whakarerekē, e whakahau rānei i ngā ratonga AI a te hunga kē.
• Kāore e whakahaere i te mōhiotanga kōrero, te ihirangi, te tika rānei o ngā whakautu AI, te putanga reo, te takaroa, te pūmautanga whatunga, te wāteatanga ratonga rānei.
• Kāore e tuku tūmataitinga mai i te ratonga AI ake. Ka panoni a Puzru i te wāhi e purei ai te ororongo reo e tautokona ana ki tō pūrere, kaua ko te āhua e whakahaere ai te ratonga AI i tō kōrerorero.
Kāore i taea te tiaki i te pūrongo tātaritanga.
Kāore he taupānga hototahi hei tuku i tēnei pūrongo.
Kāore te pūrongo tātaritanga i te wātea.
Kāore i taea te whakarite i te pūrongo tātaritanga.
I āraia te ararere e te pūnaha.
I mutu te wātū ororongo i mua i te otinga o te ararere.
Kāore i taea e Puzru te tīmata te ararere ororongo.
Kāore i taea e Puzru te whakarite ororongo whakawhitiwhiti.
Kāore i whakaaetia te tono ararere ki te kaikorero-taringa.
Kāore i taea te whakaoti te ararere.
